2609.11620.title: A Training-Free, Alignment-Free Approach to Corporate Intelligence: Application to SEC Filings
2609.11620.paper_summary: High-dimensional dense text embeddings and large language models face real obstacles in financial-disclosure analysis: context-window limits, hallucination risk, high computational cost, and the arbitrary rotation of vector spaces across independently trained models. We present a training-free, alignment-free framework for corporate intelligence built on deterministic sparse seed vectors. Hashing word strings into a fixed high-dimensional basis places all documents and all temporal epochs in a common coordinate system by construction, removing any need for training or alignment. Accumulating these seed vectors across sentence contexts yields corpus-specific semantic signatures that compose linearly, supporting sub-second document comparison, issuer fingerprinting, tracking of how an issuer's vocabulary shifts between filings, and thematic sentence extraction, all on ordinary CPU hardware. Demonstrating the approach on a multi-year corpus of SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), we show how material corporate events, among them Boeing's 737 MAX crisis, Intel's supply-chain disruptions, and Bunge's acquisition of Viterra, emerge as distinct, interpretable semantic profiles, each traceable to the exact source sentences that produced it, with no domain-specific training and no LLM inference.
2609.11620.paper_summary_zh: 高維度的密集文本嵌入和大型語言模型在財務披露分析中面臨真正的障礙：上下文窗口限制、幻覺風險、高計算成本，以及獨立訓練模型之間向量空間的任意旋轉。我們提出了一個無需訓練和對齊的企業智能框架，基於確定性的稀疏種子向量。將單詞字符串哈希到固定的高維基礎上，通過構造將所有文檔和所有時間時期置於共同的坐標系中，消除了任何訓練或對齊的需求。在句子上下文中累積這些種子向量產生特定於語料庫的語義簽名，這些簽名線性組合，支持亞秒級的文檔比較、發行者指紋識別、跟踪發行者的詞彙在申報之間的變化，以及主題句提取，所有這些都在普通的CPU硬件上進行。在一個多年的SEC申報（10-K、10-Q、8-K）語料庫上演示這種方法，我們展示了如波音737 MAX危機、英特爾供應鏈中斷和邦基收購維特拉等重大企業事件如何作為獨特的、可解釋的語義輪廓出現，每個輪廓都可以追溯到產生它的確切源句，無需特定領域的訓練和無需LLM推理。
2609.11620.author: Jean-François Delpech et.al.
